title: Awaking mountains
html_source:
The Wicklow and Dublin mountains:

Buck faces to the mountains despite the fact the Martello Tower is open to land and sea. Stephen soon faces the sea emphasising the correspondence with The Odyssey in which Telemachus is soon to leave for Nestor.

It’s also a slight on Oliver St. John upon whom ‘Stately plump Buck Mulligan’ is based. As Joyce has decided to render himself exiled, he slights the nationalist Gogarty!
